content_text: So I was reading about the cinematography of a complete unknown, shot by Phedon Papamichael and he discussed using higher ISO levels to get deep depth of field while shooting at night with custom panavision anamorphics and while hearing about that I remembered another film shot on anamorphic taking place in New York. Manhattan, shot by Gordon Willis. In an interview he talked about how depending on what you were shooting, you’d still have a shallow depth of field no matter what (and this was on 35mm film, let alone the full frame that a complete unknown was shot in). I know you’re not a big anamorphic guy anyways but what are your thoughts on the idea of shooting for deep depth in the anamorphic format?
